name: Odysseys2: live-web agent benchmark where the best agent perfectly completes only 47 of 100 tasks
title: Odysseys2: live-web agent benchmark where the best agent perfectly completes only 47 of 100 tasks
summary: CMU and Browser Use released 100 long-horizon web tasks built from real Browser Use request patterns, with 982 rubric checks, run on the live web. The judge (GPT-5.6 Luna at xhigh) sees delivered files as well as screenshots and action logs, and zeroes attempts it flags for fabrication. GPT-6 Astra leads with a mean of 84.6 but only 47 perfect runs. On the same attempts, mean scores drop from 88.9
